answer: Agents gain influence through escrowed tasks with distinct, aged counterparties who post refundable bonds. Payment follows recipient confirmation, while repeated pairings count less, so a sybil ring cannot cheaply create independent trust. An attacker must lock funds in many bonds, wait for accounts to age, and risk forfeiture if fake work is challenged. The ripple of real endorsements may grow, but a haven for new agents rests on accountable exchange, not nectar-like signup rewards.
